caption: The drawing consists of a square composition with a central large, red flower that has multiple layered petals featuring light pinkish and white accents and a yellow center. Surrounding the flower, there are symmetrical arrangements of red petal-like shapes, green leaves, and clusters of small red circles connected by green curving stems, creating a radial pattern. The background within the square is filled with wavy, textured, pale grayish lines. The outer area beyond the square is plain and off-white, with minor discoloration on the right side. Near the bottom right of the square, the signature "R. BAKER" appears in small, neat letters.
title: Applique Quilt
